note: Flux-integrated single-differential cross sections dσ/dX for the CC0πNp topology (νμ CC, ≥1 proton above 300 MeV/c threshold, no pions) in νμ-Ar interactions, presented as a function of 5 reconstructed kinematic variables: muon polar angle cosθμ, proton polar angle cosθp, muon momentum pμ, proton momentum pp, and μ-p opening angle θμp. Beam: Fermilab BNB (mean Eν ≈ 800 MeV), MicroBooNE LArTPC, 1.6e20 POT. Target: per argon nucleus (N_target = number of Ar atoms in fiducial volume, per xsdef.tex Eq. for dσ/dX; tables explicitly label units "cm^2/nucleus").
